name: sky-score
description: AI-Powered Property Noise Intelligence for London and New York

scripts.lint: eslint index.html *.js js/api-base.js scripts tests mobile/scripts
scripts.lint:html: html-validate index.html changes.html pricing.html privacy.html api/index.html score-demo/index.html score-demo/api-docs.html score-demo/status.html
scripts.audit: npm run lint && npm run lint:html && npm audit
scripts.audit:security: npm audit && eslint index.html && ruff check backend/lambdas/
scripts.build:android: cd mobile && npm run sync && npm run build:assets && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.upload:android: cd mobile && bundle exec fastlane android deploy_internal
scripts.submit:ios: cd mobile && bundle exec fastlane ios submit_for_review
